Cadre AI is an AI strategy and implementation firm that helps you pinpoint the right AI opportunities, implement them seamlessly, and deliver real business impact. They focus on driving real revenue growth and improving EBITDA by working department by department to identify and implement AI workflows and agents that unlock real ROI. They also train your team on how to use AI effectively. More: https://cadre.ai/

Would you like to talk with an AI strategist about your specific needs?

Cadre AI offers four main services:

- AI Strategy: Includes the 45-day AI Transformation Intensive that delivers a prioritized, actionable roadmap with ROI estimates and a 3-year plan.
- AI Leadership & Facilitation: Helps executives and teams become AI-ambitious through workshops and sessions focused on real problems.
- AI Engineering: Connects systems, automates workflows, and builds custom AI solutions only when needed.
- AI Agents: Builds AI assistants and agents for tasks like intake, support, and routing with guardrails and human oversight.

More details are at https://cadre.ai/. Would you like to discuss which service fits your needs with an AI strategist?

The AI Transformation Intensive takes 45 days. It guides you from zero clarity to a prioritized roadmap your team can execute, including ROI estimates and a 3-year roadmap. More details are at cadre.ai/strategy. Would you like to discuss how it could fit your business with an AI strategist?

Cadre offers several AI Leadership & Facilitation session formats for executive teams, including:

- 2-Day Leadership Intensive  
- 1-Day Workshop  
- Half-Day Executive Session  
- 1-Hour Virtual Kickoff  

In these sessions, participants work on their own problems and identify 3-5 specific areas where AI could drive impact. More: cadre.ai/leadership-facilitation. Would you like me to connect you with a strategist to discuss which format fits your team best?
